**LLMs do very well on exam questions, especially when the answer is short.**

Frontier LLMs have very high accuracy on typical exam questions up to the PhD and professional level:

- SAT – 89% vs human average of 66%.
- LSAT – 87% vs human average of 56%.
- GMAT/GRE – 87% vs human average of 85%.
- OpenAI software engineering job interview questions: 92%.

However it is notable that most benchmarks rely on *short answer* questions, i.e. they are not evaluated on essays or research papers. Short answer questions are popular in part because they can be automatically graded by a computer, whereas long answers typically require human grading, and so there is far less data available.
